en.html:
Ichijou"Hah! Such big talk, and now your hands are on leave?!"
Raichou"…………"
Ichijou"Same bloody story with all of you. Power in your hand, and other people do the work. That is your whole talent, saalon. On your own, not one damn thing."
Ichijou"Useless showpiece! DIE! MASAMUNE!"
Masamune《ONE OF THE SEVEN MECHANISMS… OBORO—SHOUSHIKEN!!》

Masamune《N-NOT ONE SCRATCH?! SO MUCH ATTACK AND ZERO SCRATCH?!》
